purpose: Document a safe manual deployment rollback procedure

manual_procedure.verification: Record the deployment error and timestamp

manual_procedure.action: Identify the last known-good immutable Docker image
manual_procedure.verification: Confirm the image digest and deployment record
Confirm required backups exist and are readable

manual_procedure.action: Run application health and HTTPS smoke tests
manual_procedure.verification: Confirm expected responses and valid TLS
Save logs, image digest, and test results

safety_notes: Do not use an unpinned latest image as a rollback target.
Application rollback does not automatically reverse database migrations.
Never commit secrets, access tokens, or private keys to this file.
This file documents a procedure; it does not perform rollback.
